name: zyx-authoring-mcp-staging
description: Author staging Zyx content through MCP quality gates.

interface.shortDescription: Author staging Zyx content through MCP quality gates.
interface.longDescription: Provides one end-to-end authoring pipeline and five independently invocable specialist skills for prompt-only Source Pack, Idea Bundle, Product Bundle, Question Bank, and historical reference authoring. The remote MCP server serves active stage playbooks via workflow.get_playbook and remains the authority for authentication, schema validation, provenance, quality gates, and staging.
defaultPrompt: Use only the zyx-authoring-staging MCP connection for this task. Do not substitute another Zyx environment.
Run or resume the end-to-end authoring pipeline from course sources through validated Idea and Product Bundles.
Build a Source Pack from stored course PDFs and validate it through Zyx MCP.
Author an Idea Bundle from a validated Source Pack.
Author a Product Bundle from published Ideas.
Author an Idea-linked Question Bank draft for admin review.
Ingest stored historical question and solution PDFs into immutable attributed reference records.
